text: The wife of al-Aziz, the woman of that house, tried to seduce him. She closed the doors and said: "Come."
He said: "I seek the refuge of Allah. He is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed."
And he saw the proof of his Lord. Allah turned evil away from him, for he was one of Allah's chosen servants.
They both raced to the door. She grabbed him... and tore his shirt from the back.
And at the door... stood her husband.
At once she blamed him, and demanded prison, or a painful punishment.
Yusuf said: "It was she who sought to seduce me."
Then a witness from her own family said: look at the shirt. If it is torn from the front, she is telling the truth. If it is torn from the back... she has lied.
They looked. The shirt was torn from the back.
His second shirt. The first one told a lie about him. This one told the truth.
